item.title: Inkvolt PDF 1.3.0
item.description:
Compare Files, digital signatures, Batch with presets and watched folders, Reduce File Size, headers, footers, watermarks and Flatten come to Inkvolt PDF for Mac.
- Compare Files… (File menu): pick the original and the changed version (an open document or any PDF) and see them side by side, page by page, with every inserted, removed and changed word marked on both sides and listed to step through. Text that only moved to the next page isn't a change; a removed or added page is one change. Visual overlays the pages (only in the original: red, only in the changed file: blue) for drawings and scans. Annotated Copy makes a copy of the changed file with every change as a comment, to save and share. - Digital signatures: the Signatures pane in the sidebar (View › Show Signatures) checks every signature when you open a PDF and after each change: valid, changed after signing, changed in ways the signature doesn't allow, or invalid, with the signer, the time, the certificate and whether your Mac trusts it. Inkvolt PDF warns before an edit would invalidate a signature. - Sign Digitally… (Tools menu, the Signature tool, or a click on an empty signature field): sign with a digital ID from your keychain (smart cards too), a .p12 file, or a personal ID made for you; drag where the signature goes, choose what it shows (your handwritten signature beside it, if you like), add a trusted timestamp or certify the document, then save the signed copy. - Batch (File menu, and the start page): the same actions on many PDFs and pictures, saved to a folder with names from a template: reduce file size, protect or unprotect, sanitize, redact patterns, check redaction, report what's in each file, watermark, header and footer with Bates numbers, rotate, flatten, recognize text, export to Word, Excel, text, page images or form data. Save the list as a preset, export and import presets (the same files as on Windows), and watch folders: a file dropped in runs through a preset once it has finished copying. - The command line: `InkvoltPdf --batch preset.json files…` and `--watch folder --preset preset.json` run a preset without a window, from a terminal or launchd (`--help` explains). - Reduce File Size… (File menu): pictures downsampled to the chosen resolution, duplicates merged, streams compressed, unused objects dropped. - Add Header & Footer… and Add Watermark… (Pages menu): page numbers, dates, Bates numbers, a text or a picture across the pages, written into them so they print everywhere; Remove takes them off again. - Flatten… (Pages menu): comments and form fields become part of the pages. - Help › Inkvolt Pro…: enter an Inkvolt Pro licence key, see whom it's licensed to, or remove it. Everything in Inkvolt PDF for Mac stays free while it launches, Pro features included; a licence ($19, one time, no account, checked on your Mac and never sent anywhere) supports the project and keeps those features for you when they start asking for a key. One key works on Windows and the Mac.
For Macs with Apple silicon, macOS 15 or later. Signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple. Free software under the GNU AGPL v3; source in this repository.

item.title: Inkvolt PDF 1.2.0
item.description:
What's in This PDF comes to Inkvolt PDF for Mac.
- Tools › What's in This PDF… (also See What's in It… in Sanitize Document): one report of everything a PDF carries besides its pages: scripts and what they do, web addresses, files and programs it can reach, attachments, metadata, signatures, earlier versions, hidden layers and text, form values. Each item says whether Sanitize removes it. Save it as a web page or JSON. Nothing in the file is contacted. - Edit Text & Images: clicking text on top of a picture edits the text. - Redact by Pattern: a mistake in your own pattern is described in plain words.
For Macs with Apple silicon, macOS 15 or later. Signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple. Free software under the GNU AGPL v3; source in this repository.

item.title: Inkvolt PDF 1.1.0
item.description:
Redaction and Sanitize come to Inkvolt PDF for Mac.
- Redact areas, selected text, search matches or patterns (Social Security, phone and card numbers, emails, dates, IBANs and your own words), review the marks, then apply: what's under them is removed from the file. - After applying, a redaction check makes sure nothing of what you redacted is left anywhere in the file; Tools › Check Redaction… checks any PDF. - Sanitize Document removes metadata, hidden content, scripts, links, attachments and earlier versions before you share a PDF.
For Macs with Apple silicon, macOS 15 or later. Signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple. Free software under the GNU AGPL v3; source in this repository.

item.title: Inkvolt PDF 1.0.0
item.description:
The first release of Inkvolt PDF for Mac.
- Read PDFs in tabs, with thumbnails, the outline, find and clickable links. - Comment, highlight and draw; fill in forms; Fill & Sign with your signature. - Edit the text and pictures already on a page. - Make scanned pages searchable (OCR) and export to Word, Excel or text. - Organize pages, add bookmarks, combine files, scan to PDF, protect with a password. - Print with pages per sheet, booklets and posters. - Nothing you open leaves your Mac: no account, no tracking.
For Macs with Apple silicon, macOS 15 or later. Signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple. Free software under the GNU AGPL v3; source in this repository.
